risk_assessment.rationale: This alert is classified as high severity with an evidence count of 41. Because the sender and IP are unknown, there is a medium confidence assessment regarding its malicious nature.

recommended_actions_freeform_experimenta: Perform a retroactive search across all organizational mailboxes for any messages with the subject 'Booking confirmation for 20-22 August' to ensure no instances bypassed Mimecast.
Investigate the registration age and WHOIS data for 'grandmerchant-hotel.com'; a recently registered domain would strongly confirm malicious intent.
Extract and sandbox any URLs or attachments contained within the held message to identify potential credential harvesting sites or malware payloads.
Check if other users received similar emails from different sender addresses but with identical subject lines or patterns to identify broader campaign scope.
Block the sender domain 'grandmerchant-hotel.com' at the email gateway level and monitor for any attempted connections to associated IPs.
